needs.now: Drivable on a standard launched and seeded run.
needs.fresh: Drivable on a launched run that is not seeded.
needs.seed: Needs more seed data or a test-data helper first.
needs.fault: Needs helpers/verify fault, which makes a fake fail on demand, or a Sentinel restart mid-run.
needs.pin: Needs helpers/verify launch --pin: PINs on with Umbrel's rules and the run's test PIN.
needs.desktop-web: Needs helpers/verify launch --desktop: the desktop web app and Sentinel's --desktop options, driven in a browser.
needs.electron: Needs the Electron app run from source with its own data folder, driven with computer use.
needs.exchange-fake: Needs a local fake of the exchange APIs; Sentinel calls the real hosts today.
needs.outside: Reaches a real outside service. Check the link or request, never load it.
needs.platform: Needs a StartOS or Umbrel install.
